# netbox_device (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox device (`/api/dcim/devices/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_device" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_device" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/devices/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `airflow` (String) Airflow. Valid values: `front-to-rear`, `rear-to-front`, `left-to-right`, `right-to-left`, `side-to-rear`, `rear-to-side`, `bottom-to-top`, `top-to-bottom`, `passive`, `mixed`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `asset_tag` (String) A unique tag used to identify this device.
- `cluster_id` (Number) ID of the Cluster (`netbox_cluster`).
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to an empty string.
- `config_context` (String) Config Context.
- `config_template_id` (Number) ID of the Config Template (`netbox_config_template`).
- `console_port_count` (Number) Console Port Count.
- `console_server_port_count` (Number) Console Server Port Count.
- `cooling_intake_count` (Number) Cooling Intake Count.
- `cooling_method` (String) Cooling Method. Valid values: `air`, `liquid`, `hybrid`, `immersion`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `cooling_outflow_count` (Number) Cooling Outflow Count.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `device_bay_count` (Number) Device Bay Count.
- `device_type_id` (Number) ID of the Device Type (`netbox_device_type`).
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `face` (String) Face. Valid values: `front`, `rear`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `front_port_count` (Number) Front Port Count.
- `interface_count` (Number) Interface Count.
- `inventory_item_count` (Number) Inventory Item Count.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `latitude` (Number) GPS coordinate in decimal format (xx.yyyyyy). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `local_context_data` (String) Local config context data takes precedence over source contexts in the final rendered config context.
- `location_id` (Number) ID of the Location (`netbox_location`).
- `longitude` (Number) GPS coordinate in decimal format (xx.yyyyyy). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `module_bay_count` (Number) Module Bay Count.
- `oob_ip_id` (Number) ID of the Ip Address (`netbox_ip_address`).
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `parent_device_id` (Number) Parent Device. References `netbox_device`.
- `platform_id` (Number) ID of the Platform (`netbox_platform`).
- `position` (Number) Position. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `power_outlet_count` (Number) Power Outlet Count.
- `power_port_count` (Number) Power Port Count.
- `primary_ip4_id` (Number) ID of the Ip Address (`netbox_ip_address`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `primary_ip6_id` (Number) ID of the Ip Address (`netbox_ip_address`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `primary_ip_id` (Number) Primary Ip. References `netbox_ip_address`.
- `rack_id` (Number) ID of the Rack (`netbox_rack`).
- `rear_port_count` (Number) Rear Port Count.
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the Device Role (`netbox_device_role`).
- `serial` (String) Chassis serial number, assigned by the manufacturer. Defaults to an empty string.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the Site (`netbox_site`).
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `offline`, `active`, `planned`, `staged`, `failed`, `inventory`, `decommissioning`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `url` (String) Url.
- `vc_position` (Number) Vc Position. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `vc_priority` (Number) Virtual chassis master election priority. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `virtual_chassis_id` (Number) ID of the Virtual Chassis (`netbox_virtual_chassis`).

### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
